lines: What do you think? Do you think we can make it together from now on?
I wonder...
But for now, I want to be together.
Right, but...
I think I'll be the one who gets dumped in the end.
I wonder...
But let's at least try being together.
If you cheat, don't tell me.
If I don't know, I won't be sad, right?
I don't trust you, the way I am.
I want to face you straight on.
No matter how many times, even dozens of times,
I'll hug you, hold your hand, and kiss you.
Memories that make me grin with a yearning every time I recall them, and I can't help but feel the regret.
We'll create them together, and sure, we'll argue sometimes.
If so, I'll apologize any number of times, even dozens.
I’ll never forget to say thank you.
Sorry, sorry, thank you—at least an apology.
The risk of keeping balance is a bit high, though.
Please forgive me.
The me up to now
Feels like I've only done twisted things.
So at least to you,
I'll run straight, straight toward you.
No matter how many times, even dozens of times,
I'll hug you, hold your hand, and kiss you.
If the two of us never forget this sweet feeling,
There'll be no problem at all.
We’ll probably argue, though.
If so, I'll apologize any number of times, even dozens.
I’ll never forget to say thank you.
With you, any morning, night, or evening,
we could live laughing together.
I think so.
What do you think? Do you think we can make it together from now on?
I wonder...
But for now, I love you.
